limitations: Ancestry compares were refreshed for every listed branch head. Content decisions reuse the explicit 2026-11-19 review and are cross-checked with local source where stated; ancestry alone does not establish gameplay quality.
Three GitHub compare arrays reached the 300-file display limit; local --no-renames path comparisons verified every diverged branch without that limit.
The gh-pages comparison error is expected: website branch with no common game-source ancestor.
This inventory neither deletes branches nor replaces the original Lumo model.

local_source_verification.method: Each exact branch head is checked against its merge base. Changed source/asset/tool paths are compared by blob SHA with the baseline tree and all objects reachable from baseline history. Historical presence is evidence of earlier inclusion, not proof of runtime equivalence; prior family decisions provide the context.

snapshot_scope: 301 branches that existed when this integration inventory began. The subsequently created integration/lumo-complete-20261122 delivery branch is not included in its own source inventory.

integration_changes.change: Expose already shipped badger and cat as selectable Borin and Yuki
integration_changes.reason: Production GLBs, portrait images and adapter support existed at baseline, but the driver catalog omitted both IDs. No historical catalog unlock values were found. Both are available without a new star requirement; original four entries and existing unlocks retain their values.
integration_changes.verification: kart_extra_drivers_regression: 79 checks, selection through save/recreated-scene resume

integration_changes.change: Fix delayed preview celebration callback after race start
integration_changes.reason: The real selection-to-race regression exposed a lambda retaining a freed preview kart. A typed WeakRef safely checks the preview lifetime before ending the celebration.
integration_changes.verification: Both new drivers reach a real race and resumed race without the freed-lambda capture error.

integration_changes.change: Extend imported driver regression to all additional selectable production species
integration_changes.reason: The original model regression covered the six opponent species but omitted playable otter, badger and cat; the new flow test covers real menu and persistence integration.
